pages.title: Know Your Measure
pages.text: Choose a brew by quality and effect while understanding intoxication.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Choose a drink by its effect and quality. The Breathalyzer reports intoxication; blacking out and deliberately failing a brew are not required.

pages.title: Choose a brewed drink
pages.text: Drink type and quality change its behavior; a Breathalyzer measures intoxication. Blacking out is not required.

pages.title: Use an active brewing effect
pages.text: Some drinks affect touch interactions, replacing ordinary damage with support, healing or harm. Others affect attraction, repulsion or movement; choose using the current tooltip.
